title: RealityEngine Arbitration Registry
description: Declares how each contended universal-vector position resolves. A position is contended when more than one writer targets it, counting machine final Reality Events and PE-source contributions alike. An undeclared contended cell is a corpus error, not a runtime default (docs/ARBITER_CONTRACT.md §5). Generated by scripts/build-arbitration-registry.py; do not edit by hand.

machineContendedCells.description: Subset where more than one MACHINE writes the cell, i.e. contention that exists independently of any integration surface.

defaultProviderRanks.description: Determinism ranking used by PRECEDENCE when an entry does not override it. Higher wins. Ranked by determinism class rather than provider identity (ARBITER_CONTRACT.md §4.3a).

cell.description: Absolute position in the universal input event vector.

rule.description: Resolution rule. Must be a commutative monoid so parallel reduction in any order yields the same value (ARBITER_CONTRACT.md §4.1).

withinRank.description: Tie-break among contributions at the winning rank, for PRECEDENCE only. A cell can be contended on two axes at once — a machine determination against a generated assessment, and several machine determinations against each other. PRECEDENCE resolves the first; withinRank resolves the second. Absent means MAX, the §4.3a default.

providerRanks.description: Per-cell override of defaultProviderRanks. Raising a generated provider above a deterministic one deliberately imports irreproducibility into this lane and the rationale must say so.

writers.description: Every contributor to this cell. Fewer than two writers is not contention and must not appear in the registry.

readers.description: Machines whose declared input region covers this cell. May be empty: a contended cell no machine reads is still contended, and is worth surfacing as dead contention.

rationale.description: Why this rule. Required so a resolution decision is never inherited silently.

provider.description: Open registry, not a closed enum — integration surfaces register here (ARBITER_CONTRACT.md §3). 'machine' denotes a final Reality Event.

originId.description: Machine file for provider=machine; the PE source or projection id otherwise.
